limitations: Only nearest-neighbour, translation-invariant biased walks on labelled cycles with homogeneous discount; no claim for general directed networks, variable fidelity, or historical exhaustiveness.
scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-parameter biased-cycle and sharp four-gap drift-optimization claims are proved in full. Independent audit and historical-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Discounted hitting domination of biased cyclic walks and a sharp drift-induced coverage gain
